ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: clean hands
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Make every kitchen clean and keep butchering out of them. Fewer poisoned stomachs, fewer lost workdays.

plain.li: I cook in a room where someone butchered a muffalo yesterday. Then we wonder why half the colony is throwing up.
A clean kitchen. No guts on the floor. That's my whole proposal, and it's a good one.

warm.li: I want to feed you all without making anyone sick. Help me keep the kitchen clean.

blunt.li: The kitchen is a crime scene. Fix it, or start cooking for yourselves.

cheerful.li: Imagine it: shiny floors, no blood, meals nobody has to regret! Let's do it!

gloomy.li: Someone's going to die of a bad stew one day. I'd rather it wasn't my stew.

cold.li: Food poisoning costs us days of labor every season. Removing the cause is cheap.

plain.li: Clean floors, clean tables, clean conscience. Dinner's ready.

cheerful.li: Look at that floor! You could eat off it! Please don't, though, we have tables.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: law and order
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Build a proper prison cell, so captured raiders can be held, healed and maybe recruited.

plain.li: Every raid, we leave wounded raiders bleeding in the dirt. Some of them could be colonists one day. We need a cell.
A cell with a bed and a door. That's how strangers become neighbors around here.

warm.li: Not everyone who attacks us is a monster. Give them a bed and a chance.

blunt.li: We need somewhere to put the ones who survive. Preferably somewhere with a lock.

cheerful.li: New friends! They just don't know it yet. All we need is a cell and some patience.

gloomy.li: We can't keep doing this alone. A prison is the only recruitment office out here.

cold.li: Captured raiders are labor, information, or ransom. A cell lets us decide which.

plain.li: One cell, one bed, one door. Now we just need a guest.

cold.li: Holding facility operational. Next raid will be more productive.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: the brewmasters
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Set up fermenting barrels and put twenty-five drinks in the store: beer, or whatever the barrels make. For celebrations. And for bad days.

plain.li: Barrels, hops, patience. Give me a season and I'll give this colony a reason to sit down together.
Life is hard. Beer is easy. Let's make some.

warm.li: Something to toast with when we make it through another winter. That's all I want.

blunt.li: I am not getting through another raid sober. Barrels. Now.

cheerful.li: Our own beer! With our own name on it! I've already got label ideas!

gloomy.li: If we're all going to die out here, we might as well have a drink first.

cold.li: Beer improves morale at low cost and sells well. The math is simple.

plain.li: First barrel's tapped. Cheers, everyone. We earned it.

cheerful.li: To us! To beer! To not dying! Mostly in that order!

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: stone and mortar
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Rebuild until four out of five walls are stone or metal. Raiders bring torches; wood remembers.

plain.li: One spark. That's all it takes and half this place is ash. I want stone walls.
We built in wood because we were desperate. We're not desperate now. Let's build to last.

warm.li: I want our homes to still be standing in ten years. Stone, please.

blunt.li: We live in a bonfire waiting for a match. Stone walls. Today.

cheerful.li: Big, solid, beautiful stone walls! Fireproof AND impressive!

gloomy.li: I keep dreaming about fire. Let's at least make the dream less likely.

cold.li: Flammable walls are a structural liability. Replace them.

plain.li: Let them bring their torches.

cold.li: Fire risk reduced to acceptable levels.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: no dark corners
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Put a light in every room people work, eat or sleep in. Faster work, better moods, fewer stubbed toes.

plain.li: Half our rooms are pitch black after sundown. We work slower, we trip more, we're miserable. Lights.
I walked into a wall last night. In my own home. Let's light this place up.

warm.li: A warm light in every room makes a house feel like a home.

blunt.li: I can't see what I'm doing and neither can you. Lamps.

cheerful.li: Let's make this place glow! Every room! Cozy everywhere!

gloomy.li: The dark gets into your head after a while. I'd like it out of mine.

cold.li: Darkness costs us work speed. Lighting is cheap. Do it.

plain.li: Every room lit. Funny how much bigger the place looks.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: a master healer
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Train someone up to Medicine 10 and keep medicine stocked. The day you need a great doctor is too late to start training one.

plain.li: Somebody here has to get really good at stitching people back together. I volunteer, but I'll need practice.
A good doctor turns a death into a scar. Let's make sure we have one.

warm.li: Let me learn. I'd rather patch you up than bury you.

blunt.li: Our best doctor couldn't remove a splinter. That has to change.

cheerful.li: Doctor school! Who wants to be my first patient? Nobody? Fair.

gloomy.li: Sooner or later someone will be bleeding out on the table. I want steady hands there when it happens.

cold.li: Surgical skill is the cheapest insurance we can buy.

plain.li: We've got a real doctor now. Try not to make work for them.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: a master's hand
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Train a crafter up to Crafting 12: good gear, good trade goods, good armor when it matters.

plain.li: We wear junk and fight with junk. Let someone get good enough to make things worth keeping.
Give me the bench and the materials, and in a season I'll make armor you'd trust your life to.

warm.li: I want to make things that keep you all safe. Let me practice.

blunt.li: Our gear is garbage. I can fix that if you let me.

cheerful.li: I've got so many ideas! Masterwork everything! Well, eventually.

gloomy.li: The raiders have better gear every time. One day that'll be the difference.

cold.li: Item quality scales with skill. Investing in one crafter pays back across the whole colony.

plain.li: Look at the stitching on that. That's craftsmanship.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: the long store
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Put away 150 pemmican: food that keeps for months without a freezer. For caravans, sieges and the winter nobody planned for.

plain.li: Pemmican tastes like a boot that went to war. It also lasts for months. Let's make a mountain of it.
When the freezer fails, or the winter runs long, I want food that doesn't care.

warm.li: I'd sleep easier knowing there's food put away for the hard times.

blunt.li: Fresh food rots. Pemmican doesn't. Do the math.

cheerful.li: Snacks! Lots of snacks! Durable, travel-friendly snacks!

gloomy.li: The lean times always come. Better to be ready.

cold.li: Preserved rations decouple our survival from weather and power. Recommended.

plain.li: Enough to walk to the other side of the world on. Or survive a bad winter. Whichever comes first.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: rest for the dead
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Lay out three graves, so the dead have somewhere to go that isn't the dirt behind the barn.

plain.li: We've buried people in ditches. We can do better than that.
Somewhere to put flowers. Somewhere to say goodbye. That's what I'm asking for.

warm.li: The ones we lose deserve a place. Let's give them one.

blunt.li: Bodies in the yard aren't good for anyone. Graves.

cheerful.li: It's not cheerful, I know. But a quiet garden for the departed could be lovely.

gloomy.li: We'll all need one eventually. Might as well be ready.

cold.li: Unburied corpses depress morale. Graves are efficient.

plain.li: Quiet ground for the quiet ones. It's right.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: a seat of power
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Build a proper throne room: a throne in an impressive hall, as a noble's title demands.

plain.li: If we're going to have nobles, they need somewhere to be noble in. A throne room.
The Empire judges us by how we receive its people. Let's not be judged poorly.

warm.li: A grand hall would make our noble proud, and the rest of us too.

blunt.li: Our noble keeps complaining. Build the throne room and maybe the complaining stops.

cheerful.li: A throne! Banners! Music! Can I try sitting in it? Just once?

gloomy.li: Titles come with demands. Better to meet them before they become threats.

cold.li: Unmet title requirements cost us goodwill and mood. A throne room resolves it.

plain.li: A seat fit for a noble. Mind the steps.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: school days
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Set up three school desks so the colony's children can learn properly.

plain.li: Our children are learning from whoever's nearest. Let's give them desks and a proper place to learn.
The kids are the colony in twenty years. Let's teach them something.

warm.li: I want them to grow up knowing more than we did.

blunt.li: The children are feral. Desks. Lessons. Please.

cheerful.li: A classroom! Lessons! I'll teach them everything, even the boring parts!

gloomy.li: If we don't teach them, the Rim will. Its lessons are worse.

cold.li: Educated children become productive adults faster.

plain.li: Desks in a row, chalk on the board. Sit down, everyone, class is in.
